edges.reason: constructor sets owner = msg.sender, so the owner identity is caller controlled at deployment.
Deployment constructor writes the owner state variable.
playerRoll binds msg.sender as the player identity, event subject and payout recipient.
oddEven binds msg.sender as the player identity, event subject and payout recipient.
onlyOwner on createWinner requires msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner on sendJackpot requires msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner on ownerTransferEther lets the owner move contract funds.
onlyOwner on ownerChangeOwner lets msg.sender reassign ownership.
onlyOwner on ownerkill lets msg.sender destroy the contract.
Player payout is sent to the caller-controlled address via transfer.
rand() includes msg.sender in the seed derivation.
Fallback is payable and credits contractBalance from any caller.
nextJackpotTime is derived directly from block.timestamp.
createWinner execution depends on the miner-influenced block.timestamp gate.
Caller-supplied inviter address is forwarded to sendProportion for payout.
inviter from playerRoll can be the recipient of the referral transfer.
inviter from oddEven is forwarded to sendProportion for payout.
inviter parameter is the recipient of inviter.transfer(amount).
Referral amount flows into the external transfer value.
winner parameter is the recipient of winner.transfer(amount).
sendTo parameter is the recipient of sendTo.transfer(amount).
Withdrawal amount flows into the external transfer value.
safeAdd requires safeToAdd(a, b) before adding.
safeSub requires safeToSubtract(a, b) before subtracting.
Parameter a is consumed by safeToAdd comparison.
Parameter b is consumed by safeToAdd comparison.
Parameter a is consumed by safeToSubtract comparison.
Parameter b is consumed by safeToSubtract comparison.
Fallback recomputes maxProfit after crediting the balance.
playerRoll calls setMaxProfit after every balance change.
oddEven calls setMaxProfit after every balance change.
playerRoll delegates fee computation to getHouseEdgeFee's unchecked math.
oddEven delegates fee computation to getHouseEdgeFee's unchecked math.
playerRoll routes part of the house edge into increaseJackpot.
oddEven routes part of the house edge into increaseJackpot.
playerRoll pays the referral through sendProportion before the main payout.
oddEven pays the referral through sendProportion before the main payout.
playerRoll draws the dice result with rand().
oddEven draws the result with rand().
rand() output is derived from predictable block values and stored in seed.
playerRoll performs the external payout transfer to msg.sender.
oddEven performs the external payout transfer to msg.sender.
playerRoll writes the unchecked playerProfit arithmetic result.
oddEven writes the unchecked playerProfit arithmetic result.
playerProfit feeds the payout amount transferred to the caller.

createWinner calls the owner-only sendJackpot payout.
sendJackpot performs the winner.transfer external payout.
ownerTransferEther performs the sendTo.transfer external payout.

increaseAmount parameter is added to jackpotBlance inside increaseJackpot.

_probability parameter drives unchecked division in getHouseEdgeFee.
_betValue parameter drives unchecked multiplication in getHouseEdgeFee.
getHouseEdgeFee multiplies by the houseEdge state variable.

getHouseEdgeFee exhibits the unchecked fee arithmetic pattern.
setMaxProfit exhibits the unchecked fee arithmetic pattern.

A sendTo contract can re-enter the payable fallback during owner withdrawal.
